name: A Gnome's Respite
summary: At Windshear Crag, Gaxim Rustfizzle struggles to slow the Venture Company's push into the forest. He asks travelers to drive back its workers so he can prepare new defenses.

sections.title: A Clashing Alliance
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle represents the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences. Among Stonetalon's ancient groves, he is meant to show the nature-worshipping night elves that gnomish invention can protect their threatened lands. He combines magic, chemical brews and mechanics, but the Venture Company's relentless pace leaves him little time to build defensive devices.

sections.title: Buying Time in Windshear Crag
sections.body: Gaxim sends travelers into the smoking works at Windshear Crag to turn back the Venture Co. Loggers and Deforesters. Their retreat would give him time to organize his workshop and devise his next defense: controlled, strategic high explosives.

faq.answer: Gaxim Rustfizzle is an Alliance gnome mage and tinkerer in the Stonetalon Mountains. He works for the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences and seeks to aid the night elves against industrial invaders.

faq.q: Why is a gnome trying to protect night elf forests?
faq.answer: Gaxim believes he must prove to skeptical night elves that gnomish sciences can coexist with nature and defend their wilderness. He draws on arcanology, alchemy and engineering against unchecked industrial exploitation.

faq.q: Who are the Venture Company in Windshear Crag?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is a goblin-run merchant syndicate cutting timber and strip-mining Windshear Crag. Its loggers, deforesters and heavy machinery have overrun the valley in pursuit of profit.

faq.q: Where can the loggers and deforesters be found?
faq.answer: The loggers and deforesters work throughout Windshear Crag, the industrial basin directly east of Gaxim's position along the main road in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What does Gaxim plan to do once he gets time to think?
faq.answer: Once the goblin workers are driven back, Gaxim plans to replenish his high explosives. He intends to use targeted mountain blasts to herd and frighten the Venture Company away from the groves.

faq.q: What is the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences?
faq.answer: The Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences is a gnomish academic society. It explores how arcane spellcraft, chemical mixtures and mechanical engineering can solve practical problems across Azeroth.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see Gaxim's ambition at work: he seeks to meet the conflict between nature and civilization with ingenuity and high explosives.
As a night elf, you know gnomish machinery draws deep suspicion from Kaldorei sentinels. In Stonetalon, the Venture Company's advance makes any effective deterrent welcome.
As an engineer, you may appreciate Gaxim's faith in mechanisms and chemistry to address environmental crises, along with his fondness for high explosives.
